# 1. Environnement

```{r}
library(here)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
```

# 2. working directory

```{r}
  # Working diretory
setwd(here::here("Data", "Data entomo"))
here()
```

# 3. 

```{r}
  # IMPORT Jeu de données coléoptères
Coleo <- read.table("jeu_donnees_coleo.txt", sep = "\t", dec = ".", quote = "\"", stringsAsFactors = F, header = T) %>%
  select(6 : 7, 10 : 20)

abondance <- Coleo %>%
  group_by(Numero_de_piege) %>%
  summarise(Abondance = sum(Abondance))

barplot(abondance$Numero_de_piege, abondance$Abondance)

ggplot(abondance, aes(x = Numero_de_piege, y = Abondance)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = c("darkblue", "darkred", "darkgreen", "darkmagenta")) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Abondance), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Abondance de coléoptères saproxyliques le long d'un gradient vertical",
       x = "Pièges entomologiques",
       y = "Abondance") +
  ylim(0, 10000) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0))

Div1 <- Coleo %>%
  filter(Numero_de_piege == "1") %>%
  distinct(SP, .keep_all = T) %>%
  select(9, 13) %>%
  mutate(nbesp = 1) %>%
  summarise(nbesp = sum(nbesp)) %>%
  mutate(piege = "Piege_1")
Div2 <- Coleo %>%
  filter(Numero_de_piege == "2") %>%
  distinct(SP, .keep_all = T) %>%
  select(9, 13) %>%
  mutate(nbesp = 1) %>%
  summarise(nbesp = sum(nbesp)) %>%
  mutate(piege = "Piege_2")
Div3 <- Coleo %>%
  filter(Numero_de_piege == "3") %>%
  distinct(SP, .keep_all = T) %>%
  select(9, 13) %>%
  mutate(nbesp = 1) %>%
  summarise(nbesp = sum(nbesp)) %>%
  mutate(piege = "Piege_3")
Div4 <- Coleo %>%
  filter(Numero_de_piege == "4") %>%
  distinct(SP, .keep_all = T) %>%
  select(9, 13) %>%
  mutate(nbesp = 1) %>%
  summarise(nbesp = sum(nbesp)) %>%
  mutate(piege = "Piege_4")
Div <- bind_rows(Div1, Div2, Div3, Div4) %>%
  arrange(piege)

div_coleo <- Coleo %>%
  distinct(SP, .keep_all = T) %>%
  select(9, 13) %>%
  mutate(SP = ifelse(SP == "", NA, SP),
         nbesp = 1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SP)) 

%>%
  group_by(Numero_de_piege) %>%
  summarise(nbesp = sum(nbesp)) 
```
